title: CDIF-for-GGA: candidate disaggregation vocabulary and 9a indicator mapping
description: Candidate SKOS vocabulary of recurring disaggregation dimensions and values for the Global Goal on Adaptation indicators, with a field-by-field mapping of the ten expert-proposed water (9a) indicators into CDIF v1.1. Supplementary material for Fakhruddin & Choi, offered as candidate input to the UNFCCC Subsidiary Bodies' metadata work.
